name: codeigniter/framework
description: The CodeIgniter 2.x framework, running on PHP 5.6 through 8.5

suggest.ext-curl: Trackback and XML-RPC client over HTTP
suggest.ext-mbstring: Needed for multi-byte string handling (UTF-8 support)
suggest.ext-mcrypt: Needed to read data encrypted with the Encryption class' default (rijndael-256) cipher
suggest.ext-openssl: Encryption class backend when mcrypt is not available
suggest.ext-zip: Reading archives created by the Zip library back (used by the test suite)
